name: pavati-pustak
description: Pāvati Pustak — Digital Trust, Donation & Receipt Management

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pavati/shared && npm run build -w @pavati/receipt-engine && npm run build -w @pavati/api && npm run build -w @pavati/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pavati/api" "npm run dev -w @pavati/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pavati/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pavati/receipt-engine && npm run typecheck -w @pavati/api && npm run typecheck -w @pavati/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pavati/receipt-engine && npm run test -w @pavati/api
